newsitem.title: USA: Royal Silver says it will not buy mine.
newsitem.headline: Royal Silver says it will not buy mine.

text.p: Royal Silver Mines Inc on Friday said it decided against exercising its right to acquire the Bunker Hill Mine in Idaho, an option on which it purchased in April 1996.
In a statement, Royal Silver said its decision was reached by the company's board after performing due diligence on the property. It forecast a capital cost of $60 million to mine 2,500 tons per day.
Royal Silver said it thought environmental liabilities there were manageable and could be resolved, but a recent lawsuit and media attention had created "a climate of uncertainty."
